scripts.dev: concurrently -n tv,phone,server -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @m8/tv" "npm run dev -w @m8/phone" "npx tsx watch apps/server/src/main.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @m8/tv && npm run build -w @m8/phone
scripts.lan: npm run build && npx tsx apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.docker: npm run check:node-version && docker compose up --build
scripts.guards: npm run build && npm run guard:syntax && npm run guard:size
